Privacy policy

Your puzzle.
Your data.

Effective November 11, 2026 · Shift Square for iOS · Developer: Brian Baker

Shift Square requires no account. Your puzzles, scores and settings are saved on your device. Advertising is disabled for the public launch. This policy also explains Google services used by designated test builds and any future reviewed ad-enabled update.

Local game data

The app stores progress, saved runs, scores, earned Sparks, unlocked looks, settings and reward-recovery records in its local storage. Shift Square does not upload your saved boards or maintain a developer-run player database. Local files may be included in device backups according to your Apple settings.

You can clear gameplay progress with Settings → Reset local progress. Removing the app can also remove local data. Device backups are controlled through Apple’s settings. Resetting gameplay does not itself delete records held by an advertising provider.

Google advertising and consent services

The app contains the Google AdMob and User Messaging Platform (UMP) SDKs. In the public launch configuration, app code does not initialize their advertising or consent flows and no reward-ad offers are shown. Designated test builds may use official Google test ads. Live advertising requires a separate reviewed app update after Google’s readiness checks.

Where these services are enabled, Google may process your IP address and network information, an approximate region, app- or device-related identifiers, ad views and interactions, performance data, crash logs and other diagnostics. These support privacy choices, ad delivery, measurement, frequency capping and fraud prevention. The consent service may determine an approximate region from network information even when location permission is not requested.

In ad-enabled test or future builds, Shift Square configures AdMob for non-personalized ads, disables publisher first-party ID and automatic coarse-location collection, and does not request Apple’s tracking permission or device location permission. These settings do not make advertising anonymous or eliminate all service data processing. Google’s SDKs have their own data practices and retention periods.

In builds with advertising enabled, applicable privacy choices are presented before an optional ad. When available, Settings → Ad privacy choices lets you revisit them. You may decline optional ads and continue normal play. Read Google’s privacy policy and how Google uses information from apps.

Sharing and clipboard

Challenge codes and diagnostic summaries are shared only when you use the system share sheet. The app reads clipboard text only when you tap Paste. A diagnostic summary includes versions and gameplay totals, without personal identifiers or full saved boards. The service you choose to share through has its own privacy policy.

Support messages

If you email relativityrush@gmail.com, the developer receives the address, message and any attachments you send. This information is used to respond to your request, investigate issues and maintain necessary support records. It is not added to a marketing list. Support email is handled through Gmail, subject to Google’s service practices. Please send only information needed for the issue.

Retention and your choices

Local progress remains until you reset or remove it. Support correspondence is kept only as reasonably needed to answer and follow up on the request, resolve disputes or meet applicable obligations. To ask about access, correction or deletion of support information, email the address below. We may need enough information to verify the request. We cannot directly erase data independently held by Google or Apple; their privacy tools and policies apply.

Children and permissions

Shift Square is a general-audience puzzle game, not a child-directed service. It does not ask for a date of birth, camera, microphone, contacts or location access. If you believe a child has sent personal information to support, contact us so we can review and delete it as appropriate.

This website

These support pages do not include developer-added advertising, analytics scripts or forms. The hosting provider may process ordinary request information needed to deliver and secure the website. Clicking an email link opens your own email app; it does not submit a message automatically.

Policy updates and contact

We may update this policy when the app or its services change. The effective date above identifies the latest policy. For privacy questions or requests, contact Brian Baker at relativityrush@gmail.com and mention Shift Square.
